newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Algeria's parliament extended to hold more MPs.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's parliament extended to hold more MPs.

text.p: More than 200 workers from 30 firms have been working against the clock to prepare the Algerian parliament to accommodate a newly-elected 380 MPs next Sunday.
The official news agency APS said on Friday that work started late in March to extend the chamber which now had to hold more than an extra 80 MPs. The assembly holds its first session on June 15.
"Teams on the spot have often been working during the night to be ready on time," APS quoted a project leader as saying.
Algeria last week held its first general election for more than five years.
